stepBody: Mir runs a stochastic gradient descent algorithm. He initializes the model's weights as $$\theta_0**{(0)}=4$$ and $$\theta_1**{(0)}=1,$$ then randomly selects the data point $$x_i=2$$ to perform one stochastic gradient descent update. After running one iteration, Mir updates $$\theta_1$$ to be $$\theta_1**{(1)}=-5.$$ What was Mir's learning rate $$(\alpha)$$ for this update?
